$description: Choctaw Nation of Oklahoma design tokens. Three brand contexts share one structure: nation (tribal-wide / strategic plan), oe (Operational Excellence department), retail (Travel Plaza / retail sub-brands). Values marked 'sampled' were measured from supplied logo files and should be confirmed with the Division of Marketing & Communications.

nation.source: Layout & Presentation Job Aide; 2026-2030 Strategic Alignment one-pager

primary.name: Flag Purple
primary.use: Title, divider and closing slide backgrounds. High impact.

primary-deep.name: Heritage Purple
primary-deep.use: Footer bands, headline text on white (as used in the Strategic Plan).

accent.name: Sky Blue
accent.use: Primary accent: infographics, chart lines, links.

alert.name: Crimson Red
alert.use: Call-to-action only. Warnings, key metrics, focal points. Use sparingly.

ornament.name: Lakna (Gold)
ornament.use: Decorative border accents and geometric framework only — never body text.

ornament-on-primary.name: Lakna (Gold)
ornament-on-primary.use: Eyebrows and motif bands on primary-colored backgrounds.

surface-alt.name: Mist
surface-alt.use: Ultra-light panel background on content pages.

text.name: Charcoal
text.use: Body text. Use instead of pure black.

oe.source: Operational Excellence Color Scheme / Branding sheet

primary.name: Dark Green
primary.use: Primary brand color: headers, title backgrounds.

primary-deep.name: Deep Green
primary-deep.use: Derived shade for footers and hover states.

accent.name: Gold
accent.use: Primary accent: rules, highlights, chart emphasis.

alert.name: Crimson Red
alert.use: Borrowed from Nation palette for warnings only.

ornament-on-primary.name: Gold
ornament-on-primary.use: Eyebrows and motif bands on primary-colored backgrounds.

neutral.name: Medium Gray
neutral.use: Dividers, disabled states, secondary chart series.

text.name: Black
text.use: Per OE sheet. Prefer #222222 for long-form reading.

retail.source: Choctaw Travel Plaza wordmark, feather mark and diamond mark (sampled)

primary.name: Plaza Brown
primary.use: Wordmark color; headers and primary backgrounds.

alert.name: Diamond Red
alert.use: Diamond mark center; KPIs and calls to action.

ornament-on-primary.name: Light Taupe
ornament-on-primary.use: Eyebrows and motif bands on primary-colored backgrounds.

seal.$description: Colors of the Great Seal artwork (sampled). Reference only — never recolor the seal and never use it decoratively.

chahta-spirit.$description: 'Living out the Chahta Spirit' tagline graphic (sampled).

scale.$description: Points for slides (from Job Aide); px equivalents at 1920x1080.
